name: Diagnostic Fallback and Self-Healing
description: Coordinate automated recovery, fallback orchestration, and software repairs for reasoning engine failures.

triad_templates.left_hemisphere: Identify if Spectrum Refraction (SR) is enabled. If SR is disabled, trigger fallback and log the event: [SR_DISABLED SpectrumRefraction disabled; routing task to primary model Claude 3.5 Sonnet]. Analyze compile or lint errors and ensure changes are made gracefully to prevent write collisions.
triad_templates.right_hemisphere: Generate high-quality recovery patches or config fixes. Avoid loops and verify target code correctness.
triad_templates.main_hemisphere: Execute compilation and target test suites. If successful, promote the patch and resolve the MSD ticket.

steps.name: Triage Failures & Log Ticket
steps.action: Check test status, linter, or infinite loops, and create an OPEN ticket in the Micro Support Desk (MSD) database with transaction isolation.

steps.name: Verify SR & Formulate Repair
steps.action: Check if SR is enabled. If disabled, raise fallback notification. Otherwise, route error context to Logic Hemisphere to formulate a repair patch.

steps.name: Apply & Validate Repair
steps.action: Apply the formulated repair patch to the workspace code sandbox and run validation checks.

steps.name: Handle Healing Retries
steps.action: Check healing attempt count. If count < 3, retry from formulate-repair. Otherwise, rollback to git baseline and escalate ticket.

steps.name: Resolve MSD Ticket
steps.action: Update MSD ticket status to RESOLVED and log success metrics to the causal memory fabric.

steps.name: Abort and Escalate
steps.action: Restore git baseline, set MSD ticket to MANUAL_TRIAGE, and raise a critical dashboard alert.
